profile.dividendPolicy:
The company's dividend policy is to pay shareholders no less than 40% of the net profit based on the company's separate financial statements, after deducting all reserves required by law and the company's regulations each year. The dividend payment will depend on various factors primarily for the benefit of shareholders, such as economic conditions, operating performance, financial position, net cash flow, cash reserved for future investments, cash reserved as working capital for the company, and the dividend payment must not materially affect the company's normal operations, as deemed appropriate by the Board of Directors. The dividend may be paid in cash or in the form of the company's ordinary shares. The company has a policy to pay dividends for the maximum benefit of shareholders and the company.
The Board of Directors may consider paying annual dividends, which must be approved by the shareholders' annual general meeting, except for interim dividends, which the Board of Directors has the authority to approve and pay from time to time when deemed that the company has sufficient profits. Such interim dividends shall be reported to the shareholders at the next meeting
